**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry into `[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)`.**

Out of 380 commits, one breaking change, one new feature, ten real fixes. Everything else was dep bumps, refactors, and test churn.

| Section | Count | Highlights |
|---|---|---|
| Breaking | 1 | expired tokens now `401`, not `403` |
| Added | 1 | webhook retries with backoff |
| Fixed | 10 | trace id dropped on retry, null cursor crash, duplicate header, request body logged in full, latency units wrong |

Next: check the breaking change and the request-body-logging fix against your security/API disclosure process before publishing.
